summary: Stops JoinAggregateTransposeRule from pulling an Aggregate with an empty group set above a join unless metadata proves its input non-empty, fixing lost rows on empty input.

tests.evidence: Bug fix; three plan tests (empty, possibly empty, known non-empty) plus a Quidem result test that mihaibudiu asked for ('can you add a quidem test which exhibits the bug?'), present in the labeled snapshot.

user_docs.evidence: Internal rule fix; no documented behavior.

doc_comments.evidence: Three-line inline comment explains the guard; accurate.

change_description.evidence: Description explains the bug and fix clearly, though the PR template text is left in the body.

performance.evidence: One metadata call in matches(); negligible.

backward_compat.evidence: Rule now fires in fewer cases, changing plans only where the old result was wrong.

correctness.evidence: Semantic guard on a rewrite rule; mihaibudiu checked that it is conservative in the right direction (Boolean.FALSE.equals(mq.isEmpty(...)) so unknown means no rewrite).

spec_conformance.evidence: SQL semantics of scalar aggregates on empty input are the bug's premise, not an interpretation question.

plan.why: Five-line guard with focused tests; one reviewer suffices.
